$schema_note: Per-type stat/formation/growth dials for the typed unit model. Decisions + rationale live in docs/design/squad-group-system.md §1/§2/§4. All values are PROTOTYPE DIALS (first pass, unmeasured) — same status as economy.json and squads.json.
note: Records the SHIPPED CVAR DEFAULTS this spec proposes (Swarm.Formation.<Type>.*, Swarm.<Type>Combat.* — CVar names to be finalized by whoever implements task-046), the same role squads.json already plays for allocation dials. Not a runtime-read table; CVars stay the live source of truth so these remain tunable while the game runs, per SwarmFormation.h's own stated reasoning.

spearmen.note: Mechanically today's retinue, renamed and formalized as a type. Stats are the shipped Gate 1 defaults, unchanged (docs/GATE1-FUN-PROTOTYPE.md §3b 'shipped defaults').

stance_reflavor.follow: escort at FollowEngageRange, engage what comes close

archers.note: New in this revision. UNMEASURED — needs the same zero-input-baseline treatment GATE1-FUN-PROTOTYPE.md §3 gave the original retinue tuning before these numbers should be trusted for balance.

stance_reflavor.follow: hold formation, engage anything inside EngageRange without closing distance
stance_reflavor.charge: Volley Advance (rate/cleave bump, not movement — never closes to melee)
stance_reflavor.hold: Loose from Cover (anchors identically to Follow; value is in addressing one unit)
stance_reflavor.rally: Fall Back (collapses behind the nearest Spearmen unit if one exists, else the hero)

allocation.unit_claim_order_note: Spearmen claim their fair share of MaxSquads (docs/data/squads.json squad_manager.max_squads) first; Archers get the remainder. See squads.json squad_manager.typed_allocation for the formula this feeds.

ranged_combat_model.note: Minimum viable model (spec §2): reuses the existing StrikeReachSq/BlowsClaimed grid mechanism with a larger EngageRange. min_engage_range per type is the only line-of-fire mitigation — an approximation (archers won't target anything already in melee range of anyone), not true LOS. The volley visual is a render-only cue (an arc/trail on SwingBit), out of this file's scope — a performance-director / render-bridge ask, not a sim mechanic.
